analysis_definition: Sum of the measured wall clock of the two invocations that made live model calls. Includes one superseded set of reasoning calls (run 1's stages 3-4) that were discarded and re-run after a Stage 2 fix, so this is the total cost in time of producing these findings, not the minimum achievable.

producing_runs.produced: Stage 1 extractions for all 2,398 work orders (2,388 live calls)
producing_runs.superseded: Its stages 3-4 ran against a 57-candidate set and were discarded when the serial-cohort grouping and examine-depth were fixed.

producing_runs.produced: Stages 3-4 for all 31 examined candidates (64 live calls). Stage 1 replayed from cache at zero cost.
